By reviving donated human organs with advanced perfusion technology, we generate a new kind of integrated human data that captures the full complexity of human biology. Through what we call Human Data Trials, we then transform this information into decision grade evidence on safety, dosing, and efficacy — all before putting a single patient at risk. Just as importantly, Human Data Trials create a new path for organ donation when a donor’s organs cannot be used for clinical transplant. This path transforms the loss of one life into discoveries with the potential to unlock the future of medicine and thereby create a lasting legacy for that patient and their family.

long_description: Reevo, Inc. is an AI-native technology company founded in 2024 and based in Menlo Park, California. It specializes in the Go-To-Market (GTM) sector, offering a unified platform known as the Revenue Operating System. This platform integrates various marketing, sales, and customer success tools into a single ecosystem, enhancing the efficiency of revenue teams. The Revenue Operating System features a range of tools, including a unified CRM and sales engagement system, a centralized prospect database, and advanced conversational intelligence. It automates administrative tasks, provides real-time performance dashboards, and delivers data-driven insights to streamline the entire revenue lifecycle. Reevo targets B2B organizations, serving marketing, sales, and customer success teams of all sizes, from startups to large enterprises. The company aims to transform how these teams operate by replacing fragmented tools with a cohesive, AI-driven solution.
